header.title: Security & Data Protection
header.subtitle: How TenthMatrix protects your data and maintains cybersecurity

introduction.title: Our Commitment to Security
introduction.content: At TenthMatrix, security is not an afterthought—it's the foundation of everything we build. We implement comprehensive cybersecurity measures, data protection protocols, and compliance frameworks to ensure your data remains safe, private, and under your control. This page outlines our security practices, certifications, and commitment to protecting your business-critical information.

sections.title: Security Overview
sections.content: Our multi-layered security architecture is designed to protect against modern cyber threats while maintaining system performance and usability:
items: Zero Trust Architecture: Never trust, always verify—every access request is authenticated and authorized
Defense in Depth: Multiple layers of security controls to protect data at every level
Continuous Monitoring: 24/7 threat detection and incident response
Security by Design: Security considerations integrated into every stage of development
Regular Audits: Third-party security assessments and penetration testing
Compliance First: Adherence to international security standards and regulations

subsections.subtitle: Encryption at Rest
subsections.content: All data stored on our systems is encrypted using industry-standard encryption:
items: AES-256 Encryption: Military-grade encryption for all stored data
Database Encryption: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for all databases
Backup Encryption: All backups are encrypted before storage
Key Management: AWS KMS and HashiCorp Vault for secure key storage
Hardware Security Modules: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified HSMs for cryptographic operations

subsections.subtitle: Encryption in Transit
subsections.content: Data moving between systems and users is protected using:
items: TLS 1.3: Latest transport layer security for all connections
Perfect Forward Secrecy: Unique session keys prevent retrospective decryption
Certificate Pinning: Protection against man-in-the-middle attacks
End-to-End Encryption: Available for sensitive AI agent conversations
VPN Support: Encrypted tunnels for enterprise deployments

subsections.subtitle: AI Model Security
subsections.content: Special protections for AI/ML models and training data:
items: Model Encryption: All AI models are encrypted at rest and in transit
Secure Inference: Isolated execution environments for AI predictions
Training Data Protection: Customer data is never used to train public models without explicit consent
Federated Learning: Train models without centralizing sensitive data
Differential Privacy: Protect individual data points in aggregated analytics

sections.title: Access Control & Authentication
sections.content: We implement robust access controls to ensure only authorized users can access systems and data:

subsections.subtitle: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
items: MFA required for all user accounts
Support for TOTP, SMS, email, and hardware tokens (YubiKey, etc.)
Biometric authentication (fingerprint, Face ID) for mobile apps
Conditional MFA based on risk factors (location, device, behavior)

subsections.subtitle: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
items: Granular permissions based on job function and need-to-know
Principle of least privilege—users only get minimum necessary access
Automatic access revocation on role change or termination
Regular access reviews and recertification

subsections.subtitle: Single Sign-On (SSO) & Identity Management
items: SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 support for enterprise SSO
Integration with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin
Just-In-Time (JIT) user provisioning
Automated user lifecycle management via SCIM

subsections.subtitle: API Security
items: API key authentication with rate limiting
JWT tokens with short expiration times
OAuth 2.0 for third-party integrations
IP whitelisting for sensitive operations
API request signing to prevent tampering

sections.title: Infrastructure & Network Security
sections.content: Our cloud infrastructure is hardened against attacks and designed for resilience:
items: Cloud Security: AWS and GCP infrastructure with security best practices
Firewall Protection: Multi-layer firewalls (network, application, web application firewall)
DDoS Protection: CloudFlare and AWS Shield for distributed denial-of-service mitigation
Network Segmentation: Isolated VPCs, subnets, and security groups
Intrusion Detection: IDS/IPS systems monitoring all network traffic
Container Security: Kubernetes security policies, pod security standards
Secrets Management: Vault and AWS Secrets Manager for credential storage
Bastion Hosts: Jump servers for secure administrative access
Private Networking: VPC peering and PrivateLink for internal communication

subsections.subtitle: Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)
items: Security requirements defined in design phase
Threat modeling for all new features
Secure coding standards and training for developers
Code review process with security checkpoints
Automated security testing in CI/CD pipeline

subsections.subtitle: Vulnerability Management
items: Static Analysis (SAST): SonarQube, Checkmarx for code scanning
Dynamic Analysis (DAST): OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite for runtime testing
Dependency Scanning: Snyk, Dependabot for third-party vulnerabilities
Container Scanning: Trivy, Clair for Docker image vulnerabilities
Penetration Testing: Annual third-party pentests and bug bounty program

subsections.subtitle: OWASP Top 10 Protection
items: SQL Injection prevention via parameterized queries and ORMs
Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) protection with Content Security Policy
CSRF protection using tokens and SameSite cookies
Broken authentication prevention with strong password policies
Sensitive data exposure prevention through encryption and masking
Security misconfiguration prevention via IaC and automated hardening
XML External Entity (XXE) prevention by disabling external entities
Insecure deserialization protection through input validation

subsections.subtitle: 24/7 Security Operations Center (SOC)
items: Real-time monitoring of all systems and applications
SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) with Splunk/ELK
Automated alerting for suspicious activities
Threat intelligence integration for proactive defense
Log aggregation and retention for forensic analysis

subsections.subtitle: Incident Response Plan
subsections.content: We maintain a comprehensive incident response plan covering:
items: Detection: Automated systems identify potential security incidents
Containment: Immediate isolation of affected systems
Eradication: Remove threat actors and close vulnerabilities
Recovery: Restore services with enhanced security
Post-Incident Review: Root cause analysis and lessons learned
Communication: Timely notification to affected parties as required by law

subsections.subtitle: Security Incident Categories
items: Data breach or unauthorized access
Malware or ransomware infection
Denial of service attacks
Insider threats or policy violations
AI model poisoning or adversarial attacks
Supply chain security incidents

sections.title: Data Privacy & Protection
sections.content: We implement privacy-by-design principles and comply with international data protection regulations:

subsections.subtitle: GDPR Compliance (UK & EU)
items: Lawful basis for data processing clearly documented
Data minimization—only collect what's necessary
Purpose limitation—data used only for stated purposes
Storage limitation—data deleted when no longer needed
Data subject rights—access, rectification, erasure, portability
Privacy impact assessments for high-risk processing
Data Protection Officer (DPO) appointed and accessible

subsections.subtitle: UK Data Protection Act 2018
items: Compliance with UK GDPR post-Brexit
ICO (Information Commissioner's Office) registration
Adherence to UK data protection principles
Standard contractual clauses for international transfers
Privacy notices in plain English

subsections.subtitle: Data Residency & Sovereignty
items: UK Data Centers: Primary data storage in UK AWS regions (London)
EU Data Centers: EU customer data stored in Frankfurt/Ireland
No US Transfers: UK/EU data not transferred to US unless explicitly requested
On-Premise Option: Full data sovereignty for sensitive industries
Data Localization: Compliance with local data residency laws

sections.title: Compliance & Certifications
sections.content: TenthMatrix maintains industry-leading security certifications and compliance:
items: ISO 27001:2022: Information Security Management System certified
ISO 27017: Cloud security controls implementation
ISO 27018: Protection of personally identifiable information in the cloud
SOC 2 Type II: Annual audit for security, availability, confidentiality
Cyber Essentials Plus: UK government-backed cybersecurity certification
GDPR & UK DPA 2018: Full compliance with data protection regulations
PCI DSS Level 1: For payment card data handling (via Stripe)
HIPAA Compliance: Available for healthcare customers
FedRAMP (In Progress): For US government customers
G-Cloud 14: Listed on UK government procurement framework

sections.title: Backup & Disaster Recovery
sections.content: We maintain comprehensive backup and disaster recovery capabilities:

subsections.subtitle: Backup Strategy
items: Continuous Backups: Real-time replication of critical data
Automated Daily Backups: Full system backups every 24 hours
Geo-Redundant Storage: Backups replicated across multiple regions
Immutable Backups: Protection against ransomware deletion
Retention Policy: 30 daily, 12 monthly, 7 yearly backups
Backup Encryption: AES-256 encryption for all backups
Regular Testing: Quarterly restore drills

subsections.subtitle: Business Continuity
items: RPO (Recovery Point Objective): < 5 minutes data loss
RTO (Recovery Time Objective): < 1 hour for critical systems
High Availability: Multi-AZ deployment with automatic failover
Disaster Recovery Plan: Tested annually with simulated disasters
Alternative Sites: Ready-to-activate backup infrastructure

sections.title: Employee Security & Training
sections.content: Our people are our first line of defense. We invest heavily in security awareness:
items: Background Checks: DBS checks for all UK employees with data access
Security Training: Mandatory annual security awareness training
Phishing Simulations: Regular testing to keep staff vigilant
Secure Development Training: OWASP training for all developers
Confidentiality Agreements: NDAs for all employees and contractors
Clean Desk Policy: Physical security measures in offices
Device Management: MDM (Mobile Device Management) for company devices
Offboarding Process: Immediate access revocation upon departure

sections.title: AI-Specific Security Measures
sections.content: As an AI-first company, we implement specialized security for AI/ML systems:

subsections.subtitle: AI Model Security
items: Model Poisoning Protection: Data validation and anomaly detection in training data
Adversarial Attack Defense: Input sanitization and adversarial training
Model Extraction Prevention: Rate limiting and query monitoring
Prompt Injection Protection: Input validation and sandboxing for LLMs
Model Watermarking: Embedded signatures to detect model theft
Secure Inference: Isolated containers for model execution

subsections.subtitle: AI Ethics & Governance
items: AI Ethics Board overseeing model development
Bias detection and mitigation in AI models
Explainable AI (XAI) for transparency
Human-in-the-loop for critical decisions
Regular audits of AI behavior and outputs

subsections.subtitle: Data Protection in AI Training
items: Opt-in only for using customer data in model training
Anonymization and pseudonymization of training data
No personal data in public models
Right to data deletion extends to AI models
Private models for enterprise customers

sections.title: Third-Party & Supply Chain Security
sections.content: We carefully vet and monitor all third-party vendors and service providers:
items: Vendor Risk Assessment: Security review before onboarding any vendor
Data Processing Agreements: GDPR-compliant DPAs with all processors
Regular Audits: Annual security reviews of critical vendors
Supply Chain Monitoring: Continuous monitoring for vulnerabilities
Open Source Security: Automated scanning of all dependencies
Software Bill of Materials (SBOM): Maintained for transparency
Vendor Offboarding: Secure data deletion when relationships end

sections.title: Physical Security
sections.content: Our offices and data centers implement physical security controls:
items: Data Center Security: AWS/GCP Tier III+ facilities with 24/7 guards
Access Control: Biometric access to sensitive areas
CCTV Surveillance: 24/7 video monitoring and recording
Visitor Management: Escort required for all visitors
Equipment Security: Locked racks and cages for hardware
Secure Disposal: Physical destruction of decommissioned hardware
On-Premise Deployments: Security requirements and best practices documented

sections.title: Responsible Disclosure & Bug Bounty
sections.content: We welcome security researchers to help us improve our security:

subsections.subtitle: Bug Bounty Program
items: Public bug bounty program on HackerOne
Rewards from £100 to £10,000 based on severity
Scope includes all production systems and applications
Fast response times—acknowledgment within 24 hours
Hall of Fame for responsible researchers

subsections.subtitle: Responsible Disclosure Policy
subsections.content: If you discover a security vulnerability, please:
items: Email security@tenthmatrix.com with details
Provide sufficient information to reproduce the issue
Give us reasonable time to fix before public disclosure (90 days)
Do not access, modify, or delete user data
Do not perform DoS attacks or social engineering

sections.title: Transparency & Reporting
sections.content: We believe in transparency about our security practices and incidents:
items: Security Bulletin: Public disclosure of patched vulnerabilities
Incident Reports: Transparency reports on security incidents (when permitted)
Status Page: Real-time system status at status.workstation.co.uk
Compliance Reports: SOC 2 reports available under NDA
Annual Security Report: Summary of security improvements and metrics
Government Requests: Transparency about law enforcement requests
